pictures.scene: a long range of steep green hills rising on the left and the right of one deep shadowed valley, their upper slopes lit warm gold by early morning sun, a clear bright blue sky above them
a dark mountain ridge lying low across the bottom of the picture with a great break of bright golden light opening in the clouds high above it, the air between them deep blue and empty

an immense landscape seen from a great height, bright green and gold fields and blue water spread along the bottom edge, a wide sky full of clear light along the top edge, the whole middle deep dark air and cloud shadow
a broad flight of worn stone steps cut into a cliff of bare rock, climbing out of deep shadow at the bottom of the picture to bright warm sunlight falling across the topmost stones at the upper right

one small oil lamp burning with a clear golden flame on the stone parapet of a watchtower at night, the tower and the whole middle of the picture very dark, a band of deep blue starlight along the top edge
a huge overhanging rock throwing a deep cool blue shadow across the middle of the picture, blazing white and gold desert light on the sand at the bottom right and on the sky at the very top

a bright golden sun low on the left edge and a pale silver moon low on the right edge of one wide sky, the whole middle of the sky between them deep dark blue and completely bare, a thin dark line of hills along the very bottom

a walled stone sheepfold on a green hillside with its gate standing open, warm golden evening light along the top of the wall and across the grass at the bottom, the inside of the fold deep in quiet shadow

a worn footpath of bare earth winding out of the dark foreground and away over green hills into a wide bright morning sky, the far horizon glowing gold and blue, the path and the hillsides between deep in shadow

lines.text: I lift up my eyes to the hills.
From where does my help come?
My help comes from the LORD,
the Maker of heaven and earth.
He will not allow your foot to slip;
the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
The sun will not strike you by day,
The LORD will guard you from all evil;
The LORD will watch over your coming and going,
